body.title: [KT-88154] [2.4.20] swift pm lock file is ignored on switching version from exact to from
body.body:
- Add repro IT
- Fix by not including versions into fingerprinting for package generation.

^KT-88154

Unused import `FingerprintSyntheticPackage` (no references in this test file). This can fail compilation when warnings are treated as errors and should be removed.

This issue also appears in the following locations of the same file:
- line 24
- line 29
- line 39
- line 58
Same as in master, let's avoid this change if possible

## Pull request overview This PR improves SwiftPM import stability in the Kotlin Gradle Plugin by making the synthetic package fingerprint independent of declared SwiftPM version constraints (fixing lockfile reuse when switching `exact` ↔ `from`) and by ensuring synthetic package regeneration removes stale transitive subpackages. **Changes:** - Switch fingerprint coordination to use a version-normalized SwiftPM dependency graph to avoid regenerating/resharding synthetic packages when only version keys/values change. - Delete the synthetic project’s `subpackages/` directory before regeneration to prevent stale transitive packages from lingering. - Add/adjust integration tests covering both the lockfile behavior regression (KT-88154) and stale subpackage cleanup (KT-82823). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
